capture_mode: conservative official HM Land Registry exact-transaction residential address enrichment
source_note: The official HM Land Registry Price Paid Data report builder was run across all 88 priced, addressless appearances in the oldest remaining Savills legacy result shard, AID 678 dated 10 May 2010. Twenty-five residential matches were retained only where the exact hammer price, locality or postcode district, tenure and residential property class aligned to one compatible transaction completing within 75 days of the auction. Forty-two no-compatible-result, seventeen multi-candidate and four later-completion results were left unchanged. Original Savills/PropertyAuctions evidence and every repeat auction appearance remain preserved.
